name: blutrixx/nativephp-geo-location
description: Location in the foreground and in the background. A foreground service writes fixes to a buffer on the phone and PHP reads them later.

bridge_functions.name: GeoLocation.CheckPermissions
bridge_functions.description: What the phone allows now: location, background location, notifications, location switched on, tracking running

bridge_functions.name: GeoLocation.RequestPermissions
bridge_functions.description: Ask for location (and notifications on Android 13+); with background=true, ask for 'all the time'. Check CheckPermissions afterwards

bridge_functions.name: GeoLocation.GetCurrentPosition
bridge_functions.description: One position now: a recent known one, or a fresh fix within the timeout

bridge_functions.name: GeoLocation.StartTracking
bridge_functions.description: Start the foreground service that records fixes to a buffer on the phone, also while the app is closed

bridge_functions.name: GeoLocation.StopTracking
bridge_functions.description: Stop the service; the buffer stays unless clearBuffer is true

bridge_functions.name: GeoLocation.Drain
bridge_functions.description: Read buffered fixes from a byte cursor; returns the fixes and the next cursor

bridge_functions.name: GeoLocation.Trim
bridge_functions.description: Drop buffered fixes before a cursor, after they are saved elsewhere

bridge_functions.name: GeoLocation.Status
bridge_functions.description: Tracking state, last fix time, number of fixes, buffer size, last error

bridge_functions.name: GeoLocation.OpenSettings
bridge_functions.description: Open Android's location settings or the app's settings page
